tools.name: meilisearch_get_version
tools.description: Get the Meilisearch version, build commit and build date of the server. Good first call to check the connection. Meilisearch API: GET /version.

tools.name: meilisearch_list_indexes
tools.description: List the indexes (uid, primary key, created and updated times) with paging. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_index
tools.description: Get one index by uid: its primary key and its created and updated times. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_index_stats
tools.description: Get the document count, storage size, indexing state and the count of documents per field of one index. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}/stats.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_stats
tools.description: Get the database size, the last update time and the document count and indexing state of every index. Meilisearch API: GET /stats.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_settings
tools.description: Get all settings of one index: searchable, displayed, filterable and sortable attributes, ranking rules, synonyms, stop words and typo tolerance. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}/settings.

tools.name: meilisearch_list_tasks
tools.description: List asynchronous tasks (document additions, index changes, settings updates) with their status. Newest tasks come first by default; set reverse to true for oldest first. Use it to see what is still processing or failed. Meilisearch API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by uid: its status, its type, the error if it failed, and its timings. Meilisearch API: GET /tasks/{taskUid}.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_documents
tools.description: List documents of one index with paging. Pick fields to return and a filter (filterable attributes only). Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}/documents.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_document
tools.description: Get one document by its id, optionally with only some fields. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}/documents/{documentId}.

tools.name: meilisearch_search
tools.description: Run a typo-tolerant search in one index, with filters, sorting, facet counts and highlighting. Meilisearch API: POST /indexes/{indexUid}/search.

tools.name: meilisearch_multi_search
tools.description: Run up to 20 searches over one or more indexes in one request. Each query names its index. Meilisearch API: POST /multi-search.

tools.name: meilisearch_create_index
tools.description: Create an empty index with a uid and an optional primary key. Returns a task: check it with meilisearch_get_task. Meilisearch API: POST /indexes.

tools.name: meilisearch_upsert_documents
tools.description: Add documents to an index, or update them when their id exists (fields not sent are kept). Asynchronous: returns a task. Meilisearch API: PUT /indexes/{indexUid}/documents.

tools.name: meilisearch_delete_document
tools.description: Delete one document by its id. Asynchronous: returns a task. Other documents are not touched. Meilisearch API: DELETE /indexes/{indexUid}/documents/{documentId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: meilisearch_search, meilisearch_multi_search, meilisearch_create_index · Private data: meilisearch_get_index_stats, meilisearch_get_stats, meilisearch_list_tasks, meilisearch_get_documents, meilisearch_get_document, meilisearch_upsert_documents, meilisearch_delete_document · Public sink: meilisearch_search, meilisearch_multi_search, meilisearch_create_index · Destructive: meilisearch_search, meilisearch_multi_search, meilisearch_delete_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: meilisearch_search, meilisearch_multi_search, meilisearch_create_index · Private data: meilisearch_get_index_stats, meilisearch_get_stats, meilisearch_list_tasks, meilisearch_get_documents, meilisearch_get_document, meilisearch_upsert_documents, meilisearch_delete_document · Public sink: meilisearch_search, meilisearch_multi_search, meilisearch_create_index · Destructive: meilisearch_search, meilisearch_multi_search, meilisearch_delete_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
